findings.title: Faded support text
findings.why: Light grey support text that passes the bare minimum still reads as faded; it is the "muted subtitle" look of generated pages and tires the eye.
findings.fix: Readable text at 7:1 or more (4.5:1 from 24 px up). Rank with size and weight, not by greying text out.

findings.title: Heading plus grey subtitle, section after section
findings.why: A heading followed by a smaller, greyed paragraph in every section is the template rhythm of generated landing pages.
findings.fix: Let the section open with its content (a product view, a table, a list) or write one sentence in the main text colour. Vary how sections start.

examples.detail: "Overdue amount, last 6 weeks" with a greyed subtitle

focal.why: headline 2.3x, largest visual 20% of the screen

visual.why: 20% of the first screen is visual (surface)

motion.why: moves outside any visual, 1 moving elements, reduced motion handled

identity.why: no web font, display face differs from text, accent used 14x in 2 hue band(s), 0 shadows, 0 layers, 0 textured areas (none)

density.why: app screen, 31 text items on the first screen

findings.title: No depth at all
findings.why: No shadow, no layered surface, one flat colour everywhere: the page looks like printed paper, not an interface.
findings.fix: Add one layer system: a raised surface for the product view (soft layered shadow), a second surface tone, or one overlapping element.

findings.title: No texture, pattern or tonal light anywhere
findings.why: Every surface is one flat fill. Good pages carry a material: grain, a faint pattern or watermark, a tonal light behind the product.
findings.fix: Add one material that suits the project: fine grain, a subtle pattern in one zone, a watermark, or a soft light behind the main visual. Keep it quiet (under 10% opacity).

examples.detail: no background image, gradient, mask or noise on any large area

findings.title: Nothing moves, even where a demo would explain the product
findings.why: A product page with a call to action but no motion leaves the reader to guess how the product behaves over time.
findings.fix: Animate the product view once: one short sequence (render(t) or a few keyframes) that shows what happens, then stops. Respect reduced motion.

examples.detail: no animation, 0 animation frames, 1 DOM changes after load

findings.title: Default system serif
findings.why: Georgia, Times and other built-in serifs are what a browser shows when nobody chose a type face.
findings.fix: Choose a face on purpose (a real web font with a licence that allows self-hosting) and pair it with one text face.
